spirit:busDefinition.spirit:name: szg_dac_ad911x
spirit:busDefinition.spirit:description: SZG-DAC-AD911X SYZYGY peripheral full pinout: 12-bit parallel data (DB0-DB11), sample clock (CLKIN), optional data clock echo (DCLKIO), SPI control (SCLK/CLKMD, SDIO/FORMAT bidir, CS_B/PWRDN), op-amp enable (OPAMP_ENABLE), and reset/pin-mode (RESET/PINMD).
